long_biography.plain_text:
Buying Heesen Yachts in 2025 took Laurens Last just five weeks, from negotiations to completing the acquisition. The Dutch industrialist had not been searching for a shipyard, but its availability prompted a rapid decision. He wanted to apply his manufacturing experience to a business whose products held a personal fascination for him.

Last appointed an experienced manufacturing executive to lead the yard and described his own contribution as strategic discussion, leaving managers responsible for solving operational problems. His plans combine more efficient production with the retention of skilled interior craftsmanship. Bringing engineers into the early stages of design allows the yard to develop technical requirements alongside bespoke interiors.
